marketing.targetReader: Shop and brand operators using an outside warehouse
marketing.readerQuestion: Does the warehouse have to pay for every difference between the ledger and physical count?
marketing.practicalPayoff: Separate the two gaps and identify the standards to put in the contract.
marketing.coverIntent: A question about warehouse inventory discrepancies and responsibility
marketing.saveValue: A record checklist to revisit when inventory differs
ctaInputs: Receipt, shipment, return and adjustment records
ctaOutcomes: Missing receipt, shipment-approval and count standards in the contract
marketing.performanceHypothesis: Test whether separating the number gaps improves saves

cards.headline:
Warehouse stock differs.
Who is responsible?
body: When quantities differ, separate the records first.
cards.takeaway: A ledger gap does not prove loss.
cards.design: 창고 선반과 두 기록지를 하나의 장면으로 그린다. 질문이 주연이고 그림은 그 아래에 둔다.
cards.oneMessage: A ledger difference does not by itself prove loss or liability.

sourceTrace.heading: 안녕하세요, 행정사 지상진입니다.

cards.headline: What if three counts differ?

body.text: Quantity managed for warehouse receipts and shipments

cards.design: 같은 기준점에서 출발하는 비례 막대 세 개. 숫자는 크게, 막대 길이는 과장 없이 표시한다.

sourceTrace.heading: 1,200개·1,150개·1,130개, 세 숫자가 모두 다른 이유
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 사용자 전체 수정 원고에서 선별·압축. 원문 밖 사실 추가 없음.

cards.headline: The 50-unit and 20-unit gaps may have different causes.

body.text: A shipment may have been recorded late in the company ledger. Check cancelled orders and the timing of return inspections.
Check whether a shelf or defective-goods area was missed. The goods may have been shipped incorrectly or actually lost.

cards.takeaway: Use one timestamp, code and unit.
cards.design: 위아래 열린 대조. 50개와 20개가 눈에 먼저 들어오고 각 원인 설명이 뒤따른다.
cards.oneMessage: Compare them using the same timestamp, product code and unit of count.

sourceTrace.heading: 1,200개·1,150개·1,130개, 세 숫자가 모두 다른 이유
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 사용자 전체 수정 원고에서 선별·압축. 원문 밖 사실 추가 없음.

cards.headline: Match the records first.
head: Records to compare
What to check

body.text: Check who changed quantity and why.

cards.takeaway: Keep the original and start at the last match.
cards.design: 기록명과 확인 질문을 연결한 대조표. 수직 골드선으로 대조의 축을 만든다.
cards.oneMessage: Keep the original before editing and start from the last time the quantities matched.

sourceTrace.heading: 숫자를 수정하기 전에 원본부터 남겨야 합니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 사용자 전체 수정 원고에서 선별·압축. 원문 밖 사실 추가 없음.

cards.headline: “Mutual discussion” alone leaves no record.

body.text: “The custodian shall store the entrusted goods with due care and handle any inventory difference through discussion between the parties.”
Record expected, inspected and confirmed receipt quantities separately, and ship through the agreed approval route. Keep the reason, time and perso…

cards.takeaway: Put the agreed process in the contract.
cards.design: 기존 조항은 인용 종이, 수정 방향은 선명한 열린 문서로 대비. 요약을 완성 계약 조항처럼 따옴표로 묶지 않는다.
cards.oneMessage: Write the parties’ agreed work process into the contract.

sourceTrace.heading: “재고 차이가 나면 협의한다”는 계약서를 어떻게 보완할까요?
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 사용자 전체 수정 원고에서 선별·압축. 원문 밖 사실 추가 없음.

cards.headline: Set the standard for a discrepancy

body.text: Compare receipt and shipment records, return and adjustment records, and the count result at the same reference time.
If loss or damage is established, assess liability and the amount of loss under applicable law and the contract.

cards.takeaway: Loss means gone; damage means harmed.
cards.design: 기록 대조에서 책임 판단으로 내려가는 두 단계 문서 구조. 책임 판단의 조건을 강조한다.
cards.oneMessage: Loss means the goods are gone; damage means the goods are harmed.

sourceTrace.heading: “재고 차이가 나면 협의한다”는 계약서를 어떻게 보완할까요?
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 사용자 전체 수정 원고에서 선별·압축. 원문 밖 사실 추가 없음.

cards.headline: When can the warehouse be liable?

body.text: Goods are held for another party.
The entrusted goods are lost or damaged.
The operator must prove due care.

cards.takeaway: First confirm entrusted, accepted and shipped quantities.
cards.design: 적용 관계와 사고 조건을 위에, 주의의 증명을 아래 굵은 법리 블록에 배치한다.
cards.oneMessage: First confirm the entrusted quantity, acceptance and shipment records, and goods that cannot be returned.

sourceTrace.heading: 실제로 보관 중 없어진 물건이라면 창고업자는 책임질까요?
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 사용자 전체 수정 원고에서 선별·압축. 원문 밖 사실 추가 없음.

cards.headline: Unauthorized shipment can count as “loss”.
body: Article 166 includes unauthorized shipment that prevents return.
cards.takeaway: Check who requested and approved shipment.
cards.design: 골드 레일을 둔 판례 요지. 판례 번호는 출처 한 곳에, 적용 범위 메모는 아래 구분선 뒤에 둔다.
cards.oneMessage: Check who requested the shipment and what approval preceded it.

sourceTrace.heading: 대법원은 ‘무단 출고’도 물건의 멸실로 봤습니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 사용자 전체 수정 원고에서 선별·압축. 원문 밖 사실 추가 없음.

cards.headline: Separate storage from transport.
body: A specific logistics contract treated multimodal transport as central.
It did not classify every fulfillment contract as transport.
cards.takeaway: Review handoff proof before and after the courier.
cards.design: 상단 작은 출고·인계 그림과 판례 요지를 결합한다. 앞 카드의 큰 인용 패널과 다른 구도로 범위 한정을 살린다.
cards.oneMessage: Separate the period before and after courier handoff, and review handoff proof and transport records.

sourceTrace.heading: 보관부터 배송까지 맡겼다면 사고가 난 단계를 구분해야 합니다
sourceTrace.compressionNote: 사용자 전체 수정 원고에서 선별·압축. 원문 밖 사실 추가 없음.

cards.headline: Prepare the contract and records.

body.text: Contract, receipt, shipment, return and count records.
Set receipt, approval and count rules. An attorney may need to review damages or limitation.

cards.takeaway: A free preliminary review can identify missing standards.
cards.design: 준비 자료는 열린 목록, 문서 작성 범위는 경계선으로 구분. 무료 사전 검토 문장만 하단 채움 띠로 둔다.
cards.oneMessage: A free preliminary review can identify which records to compare and which standards are missing from the contract.
